description:
Hushfeed v0.40.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Nine new patches, a settings screen rebuilt around how people look for things, and a night of fixes checked on a phone. A Privacy page holds everything that decides what TikTok learns, with a switch for each of the seven device patches, and the contact and installed-app blockers now read the right call sites. The settings menu is four groups, with Screen time and Backup and restore as pages of their own. The right column switches work again on 46.2.3. An overnight pass on a Galaxy S22 found and fixed four more: the quick reactions row above the comment box, saving the sound beside a video, a hold on Like that liked, and the asset strips on the newer builds.

Validation: 1405 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 90 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
